description: Fuji于1983年推出的便携相机。配备Fujinon 32 mm f/2,8 (4 elements/4 groups)。快门速度Programmed electronic, 1/40–1/400 s, self-timer.。感光度ISO 50–1600, set by DX code. Non-DX films exposed at ISO 100.。Autofocus with focus lock, 0,6 m to infinity.。

specs.对焦: Autofocus with focus lock, 0,6 m to infinity.
specs.感光度: ISO 50–1600, set by DX code. Non-DX films exposed at ISO 100.
specs.闪光灯: Built-in TTL flash, GN 10. Fill-in button on back, but no flash disable button.
